data.narrative:
Blue Energy, a Growth-stage nuclear energy company led by CEO Jake Jurewicz and Matt Slotkin, has raised $425M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 8 peers across the nuclear sector: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 5 private firms including Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, and Stratek Global.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and serves as the primary valuation anchor. Using the $425M total raised as a proxy for current implied value and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical for Growth-stage advancement yields $510M. The Peer-Median method is not applicable; while four same-sector peers exist, none satisfy the narrow filter criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier peers at sufficient count). Applying an all-sector median would introduce unwarranted noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $434M to $586M, with a median of $510M. This range reflects a ±15% confidence band around the Stage-Progression midpoint. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficient stage-matched comparables in the private nuclear frontier-tech market and inherent volatility in Growth-stage exit multiples. The single-method triangulation limits confidence; broader market data on nuclear Energy peer progressions would strengthen conviction in this range.
